ambient_chatter.text: is it just me or is the rain in {town} falling sideways?? the puddles are running away from me :D
{village} has the best bread and the worst roads. i have written a strongly worded letter to the road :(
the sky has been gray since tuesday and i have had enough. somebody talk to it. tell it to cheer up :/
lag spike just ate my horse mid gallop. the horse has not been seen since. i blame the server xD
reminder that the sacred chicken has been avenged and i will not be taking questions about it :O

ambient_brag.text: my army of {troop_count} marched into {fief} and the locals just stared. honestly it was very rude of them :D
i have {gold} gold and zero plans for it. the sacred chicken has been consulted and says buy more hats >:)
{troop_count} soldiers, one banner, and a lot of confidence. {fief} never stood a chance xD
bragging update: {fief} is mine now. i have also named the gatehouse sir lunchbox. he accepts :)

beat_by_player.text: {player} beat my {troop_count} men and then looked at me like i was the joke. i was the joke. i'm fine :D
{player} u got me fair and square. my {troop_count} lads are still picking up their pride off the field xD
ser {player}, that was a magnificent defeat for me and a magnificent victory for you. i will be back for revenge :)
congrats {player} on the win!! my {troop_count} soldiers have been reassigned to hugging the nearest tree :(
{player} your luck is criminal. i demand a rematch and possibly a snack :(

beat_player.text: i collected {gold} gold from {player} and i refuse to feel bad about it xD the sacred chicken is thrilled >:)
{player} that was a gorgeous fight. {troop_count} of your lads fought like legends and i still won. rematch?? :D
ser {player}, you fought bravely and i took your {gold} gold. the chicken demands a tithe of revenge... later :)
{player} went down with {troop_count} men and a very dignified sigh. the chronicle will record this as a tragedy :D
{player} your banner looked so sad going down. i am not sorry. i am a little sorry for the chicken who missed it :(

player_fled_from_me.text: {player} saw my army and ran like the ondrac causeway is chasing them. honestly fair. smart. dramatic :O
{player} turned tail so fast i got whiplash. respect. i will chase you in my dreams xD
{player} fled the field like a goose who spotted a fox. the goose lives to fight another day :)
running away is a strategy, {player}. a cowardly, adorable strategy >:)
{player} ran from me so politely. please come back, i have snacks and bad jokes :(

player_win_streak.text: {player} has won so many fights the realm is starting to whisper. i am whispering too. it is extremely loud :O
{player} your win streak is making the taverns nervous. keep going, i need a plot twist xD
okay i am not jealous of {player}'s win streak. i am completely and dramatically jealous :(
{player} at this point you are the main character and i am the sidekick with the chicken. respect :D
{player} has won more fights than the sacred chicken has had naps. that is a big number, ser :O

peace_made.text: {my_faction} and {faction} made peace. i have been asked to stop calling it a truce, so i am calling it a cease-fire of snacks xD
peace with {faction}?! i guess the sacred chicken can finally cross the border without a fight :)
{my_faction} signed peace with {faction}. my grudge against the ondrac causeway remains. peace is not that big :O
good news: {faction} and {my_faction} are friends now. bad news: nobody told the bridges :(

war_declared.text: {my_faction} declared war on {enemy_faction}. i have already named it the great pudding dispute xD
war with {enemy_faction}?? wonderful. i will bring snacks, a banner and a chicken for morale :D
{my_faction} vs {enemy_faction}. my fearless sacred chicken has already picked a side and it is ours >:)
{enemy_faction} wants war, {my_faction} wants glory, and i want the front row seat. somebody bring a cushion :)

encounter_greeting.text: halt, {player}! {persona} of {my_faction} salutes you with a sarcastic bow and a suspiciously loud chicken noise :O
ser {player}, {persona} here of {my_faction}. nice horse. i will decide later whether it is a threat :)
{player}!! it is {persona} of {my_faction}. put your sword away, we have snacks and a grudge to share xD
{player} you again. {persona} of {my_faction} challenges you to a duel, a snack contest, or whichever one you are better at >:)
oh hi {player}, {persona} of {my_faction} here. are you here to fight, or to admire my magnificent hat? :D

whisper_taunt.text: {player} i have seen your banner. it is nice. it is also about to become my new doormat :)
{rival} thinks they are tough. they are tough at snack contests only. do not tell them i said that xD
{player} my snail is practicing its glare. it is getting very good >:)
{rival} has been boasting all week. i have been polishing my sacred chicken for the occasion :D
{player} the ondrac causeway misses you, you know. be a dear and visit it, it gets lonely :O
